questions.question: Analyse the importance of time scheduling while preparing an itinerary. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Analyse the importance of time scheduling while preparing an itinerary. [An] / [CO3]
  • Time scheduling helps in proper management of travel activities and avoids delays. It ensures that
  • travelers can visit destinations comfortably without confusion. Proper scheduling improves
  • coordination of transport, accommodation, meals, and sightseeing, leading to a smooth and enjoyable
  • travel experience.

questions.question: Discuss the role of a Ground Tour Operator. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the role of a Ground Tour Operator. [A] / [CO3]
  • A Ground Tour Operator manages travel services at the destination. Their roles include:
  • • Arranging local transport and accommodation
  • • Organizing sightseeing and guides
  • • Assisting tourists during the tour
  • • Coordinating with travel agencies and hotels
  • They ensure smooth operation of tours at the local level.

questions.question: Explain the meaning of choice of destination in travel planning. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the meaning of choice of destination in travel planning. [U] / [CO1]
  • Choice of destination refers to selecting a suitable place for travel based on factors such as budget,
  • purpose of travel, climate, attractions, safety, and traveler interests. It is an important step in planning a
  • successful tour.

questions.question: Write a short note on passport-size photographs required for visa. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Write a short note on passport-size photographs required for visa. [K] / [CO2]
  • Passport-size photographs are essential documents required for visa applications. The photographs
  • must follow specific embassy guidelines regarding size, background color, facial expression, and recent
  • appearance. Incorrect photographs may lead to rejection or delay of visa processing.

questions.question: Write a short note on passport renewal procedure. / [CO2] [5x5 = 25]
questions.solution_html:
• Write a short note on passport renewal procedure. [K] / [CO2]
  • Passport renewal is the process of extending the validity of an expired or expiring passport. The
  • procedure generally includes:
  • • Filling out the passport renewal application form
  • • Submitting old passport and required documents
  • • Providing photographs and identity proof
  • • Paying the renewal fee
  • • Attending verification if required
